mapper.sql: select p.petition_id, p.receipt_lookup, p.receipt_hash, p.title, p.content, p.channel, p.category, p.anonymous_flag, p.reporter_name, p.reporter_phone, p.reporter_idcard, p.target_name, p.target_dept, p.amount, p.status, p.warn_level, p.handle_deadline, p.clue_id, p.feedback, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, c.clue_no as clue_no, case when p.handle_deadline is null then null else timestampdiff(hour, now(), p.handle_deadline) end as remain_hours from jc_petition p left join jc_clue c on c.clue_id = p.clue_id

select p.petition_id, p.title, p.channel, p.category, p.anonymous_flag, p.target_name, p.target_dept, p.amount, p.status, p.warn_level, p.handle_deadline, p.clue_id, p.feedback, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, c.clue_no as clue_no, case when p.handle_deadline is null then null else timestampdiff(hour, now(), p.handle_deadline) end as remain_hours from jc_petition p left join jc_clue c on c.clue_id = p.clue_id
mapper.select: select p.petition_id, p.title, p.channel, p.category, p.anonymous_flag, p.target_name, p.target_dept, p.amount, p.status, p.warn_level, p.handle_deadline, p.feedback, p.create_time, p.receipt_hash from jc_petition p where p.receipt_lookup = #{receiptLookup} and p.del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update jc_petition set warn_level = #{warnLevel} where petition_id = #{petitionId}
mapper.delete: update jc_petition set del_flag = '1' where petition_id = #{petitionId}
mapper.select: where p.del_flag = '0' and p.status not in ('6','7') and p.handle_deadline is not null order by p.handle_deadline asc

select count(1) as total, sum(case when status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as pending, sum(case when status in ('1','2','3','4') then 1 else 0 end) as handling, sum(case when status in ('5','6','7') then 1 else 0 end) as finished, sum(case when warn_level = '红灯' then 1 else 0 end) as overdue from jc_petition where del_flag = '0'

select avg(timestampdiff(hour, ta.create_time, tf.min_finish)) from jc_petition p join jc_petition_trace ta on ta.petition_id = p.petition_id and ta.action = 'accept' join ( select petition_id, min(create_time) as min_finish from jc_petition_trace where action in ('feedback','archive') group by petition_id ) tf on tf.petition_id = p.petition_id where p.del_flag = '0'

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_petition p left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_petition_status' and dd.dict_value = p.status where p.del_flag = '0' group by p.status, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_petition p left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_petition_category' and dd.dict_value = p.category where p.del_flag = '0' group by p.category, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_petition p left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_petition_channel' and dd.dict_value = p.channel where p.del_flag = '0' group by p.channel, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort

select date_format(p.create_time, '%Y-%m') as name, count(1) as value from jc_petition p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 11 month) group by date_format(p.create_time, '%Y-%m') order by name
